set: Scout stability port, stage B (indoor speed limits)
status: PREPARED, NOT WRITTEN. Written only on Ron's explicit go with this file's sha256.
scope: docs/SCOUT_STABILITY_PORT.md section B. The Scout ships with racer limits (12 m/s). Values = the reference set's, except MPC_VEL_MANUAL and MPC_XY_CRUISE: this firmware's metadata gives them a 3.0 m/s minimum (the reference set runs them at 1.5, below it), so they stay at 3.0 and MPC_XY_VEL_MAX (min 0) is the binding 1.5 m/s cap on every horizontal speed. The autonomous 0.5 m/s cap (ARCHITECTURE 8.5) is the laptop planner's, inside this.
note: Types: 9 = REAL32. Every 'current' is the live baseline value; the apply tool refuses on any drift.

writes.source: Reference value; the binding horizontal cap
